verifier_changes.new_behaviour: Those commits carry four ~1.9 GB R2-12 traces and cannot exist in the public history. shared/tooling/run_frozen_verifier.py runs the unmodified verifier with shared/tooling/gitcompat/sitecustomize.py, which answers exactly those three query types from manifests/git-object-equivalence.json, but only when the current HEAD:path Git object equals the recorded original object; otherwise it fails like a missing object. All other git commands pass through.
